the use of fibrinolytic therapy in patients with STEMI should be considered in the setting of PCI.

the use of primary angioplasty is the preferred reperfusion method in STEMI patients with a time to presentation to the hospital of less than 3 hours, whereas fibrinolysis is the preferred reparation method in STEMI patient with a time to hospitalization of more than 3 hours.
